title: First frame draws the menu with SDR-format pipelines inside the HDR10 swapchain pass
expect_note: no existing code covers a draw whose pipeline was built for different attachment formats than the active rendering pass (B8G8R8A8_UNORM menu pipeline inside the A2B10G10R10 swapchain pass); the frame-0 output is also SDR sRGB written to an HDR10 PQ target (closest: meaning.color-mismatch)
